scripts.test: oxfmt --check && bun run build && oxlint --max-warnings 0 && bun run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:unit:node && bun run test:unit:dom
scripts.test:unit:node: bun test --preload ./test-setup/node.ts packages/platforms/android/src packages/plugins/aws-device-farm/src packages/commands/test/src packages/core/reporter/src packages/commands/report/__tests__
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:unit:node --coverage && bun run test:unit:dom --coverage
scripts.build: bun run clean-dist && tsc --build && bun run --filter '@perf-profiler/web-reporter' --filter '@perf-profiler/measure' build
scripts.test:e2e: mkdir -p report && bun packages/plugins/aws-device-farm/dist/bin.js runTest --apkPath .github/workflows/example.apk --projectName 'Flashlight-Serverless' --reportDestinationPath report --testCommand 'npx ts-node examples/e2e/appium-ci.test.ts' --testFolder .
